explicit_validation.explanation: Paper explicitly compares LLM-as-a-judge results with human evaluation through correlation analysis on multiple validation rounds with sample instances

prompts.notes: Full prompts for HRS extraction and alignment evaluation are provided in appendices (Tables 13, 14, 15 mentioned in text)

guidelines.notes: Detailed definitions and scoring rubrics provided for harm reduction strategy alignment and actionability dimensions

sample_size.notes: Used random sample of 40 responses for validation on strategy extraction and combination tasks

quantitative_scores.notes: Correlation between human and LLM evaluation on strategy extraction
Correlation between human and LLM evaluation on strategy combination
Correlation between human annotation and GPT-4o's alignment score

correlation_interpretation.threshold_used: Correlation percentages reported (90-95%) implying high agreement

validation_results.summary_finding: GPT-4o shows strong correlation with human evaluation (90-95%) across multiple validation rounds, demonstrating reliable LLM-as-a-judge capability for harm reduction strategy assessment.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM handles full-scale evaluation while human validation focuses primarily on verifying LLM judgments on strategy alignment and correctness
